south.request: a tall grown townsman water carrier, a wooden yoke across his shoulders with a wooden bucket of water hanging from each end on ropes, a plain blue-grey wool shirt with rolled sleeves, brown breeches, a grey cloth cap, standing upright, full body, game npc sprite

walk.request: walking at a steady careful pace, both feet lifting in turn, the yoke across his shoulders and both water buckets swinging slightly on their ropes, the same man the whole time

idle.request: standing at ease, both feet planted and never lifting, only breathing gently, the yoke resting on his shoulders and the two water buckets hanging still, the same man the whole time
